sentences.en: About five months ago, producer Kim Chakanetza opened up a file that was sent to her by her uncle Manu.
sentences.zh: 大约五个月前，制片人金·查卡内扎打开了她叔叔马努发给她的一份文件。

sentences.en: It was an Excel spreadsheet of Kim's family tree, a project her uncle had been working on for the last several years.
sentences.zh: 那是一份金的家族谱系Excel表格，是她叔叔过去几年一直在做的项目。

sentences.en: So far, there are about 300 names on there, tracing our family's history deep into pre-colonial Zimbabwe, the country where I was born.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，上面大约有300个名字，追溯着我们家族的历史，一直深入到我出生的国家——津巴布韦的前殖民时期。

sentences.en: Ours is a typically large Zimbabwean family.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个典型的津巴布韦大家庭。

sentences.en: My great-grandfather had two wives and 15 children, and all of them went on to have a minimum of three kids each.
sentences.zh: 我的曾祖父有两个妻子，15个孩子，他们每个人后来至少都有三个孩子。

sentences.en: Soon I'll be adding a new name to the spreadsheet and upping our family's grand tally because I'll be having my first child.
sentences.zh: 很快，我就会在表格上增加一个新的名字，增加我们家族的总人数，因为我即将迎来我的第一个孩子。

sentences.en: So I've been thinking a lot about names.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在思考名字的问题。

sentences.en: My family tree seemed like a good reference point.
sentences.zh: 我的家谱似乎是一个很好的参考点。

sentences.en: My family is predominantly Shona, which is the biggest ethnic group in Zimbabwe.
sentences.zh: 我的家族主要是绍纳人，这是津巴布韦最大的族群。

sentences.en: And as I went through it, I was seeing all of the greatest hits, the classics when it comes to Shona names.
sentences.zh: 当我浏览家谱时，我看到了所有最热门、最经典的绍纳名字。

sentences.en: Tapua, which means we've been given.
Rurimbo, which translates to faith or truSt.
sentences.zh: Rurimbo，翻译过来是“信仰”或“信任”。

sentences.en: And Munyaradzi, which means to console.
There were also English names, common ones like Ruth, Gladys and Lewis.
sentences.zh: 也有一些英文名字，比如露丝、格拉迪斯和刘易斯等常见的名字。

sentences.en: But then Kim started to notice a whole other set of Western names.
sentences.zh: 但随后金开始注意到另一套完全不同的西方名字。

sentences.en: Actually, to English speakers outside Zimbabwe, they aren't so much names as they are just words.
sentences.zh: 事实上，对于津巴布韦以外的英语使用者来说，它们与其说是名字，不如说只是单词。

sentences.en: She saw one family member who was named Suffer.
sentences.zh: 她看到一位家庭成员的名字叫“Suffer”（受苦）。

sentences.en: Outside of the country, these kinds of names are rather unusual.
sentences.zh: 在津巴布韦境外，这类名字相当罕见。

sentences.en: But to me and millions of other Zimbabweans, these are fairly standard.
sentences.zh: 但对我以及数百万津巴布韦人来说，这些名字相当普遍。

sentences.en: What might surprise me is if I were to come across a boy called No Matter or Memory or Privilege,
sentences.zh: 如果我遇到一个叫“No Matter”（没关系）、“Memory”（记忆）或“Privilege”（特权）的男孩，我可能会感到惊讶，

sentences.en: because these are typically regarded as girls' names.
sentences.zh: 因为这些通常被认为是女孩的名字。

sentences.en: I have an uncle called Lovemore and I have an aunt called Loveness.
sentences.zh: 我有一个叔叔叫Lovemore（多爱），还有一个阿姨叫Loveness（爱意）。

sentences.en: God knows it's quite popular too.
sentences.zh: “God knows”（上帝知道）这个名字也很受欢迎。

sentences.en: I went to school with any more, talk more, pass more, give more, wake more.
sentences.zh: 我上学时，班里有叫“Anymore”（再多）、“Talkmore”（多说）、“Passmore”（多通过）、“Givemore”（多给）、“Wakemore”（多醒）的同学。

sentences.en: All of these were in my class.
Tanaka Chidora is a Zimbabwean writer, poet and academic.
sentences.zh: 塔纳卡·奇多拉是一位津巴布韦作家、诗人和学者。

sentences.en: Almost everyone in Zimbabwe is a relative with such a name.
sentences.zh: 在津巴布韦，几乎每个人都有这样的亲戚。

sentences.en: But to the extent that when I was growing up and I was called Tanaka, I was wondering,
sentences.zh: 但程度之深，以至于我小时候叫塔纳卡时，我都在想，

sentences.en: why didn't they also give me a name like Lovemore?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们不也给我起个像Lovemore这样的名字呢？

sentences.en: You know, because almost everyone around me had such a name.
sentences.zh: 你知道，因为我周围几乎每个人都有这样的名字。

sentences.en: If you were born in Zimbabwe like Tanaka and me, especially in the last few decades,
sentences.zh: 如果你像塔纳卡和我一样出生在津巴布韦，尤其是在过去几十年里，

sentences.en: you would have heard these kinds of names all around you.
sentences.zh: 你会听到周围到处都是这类名字。

sentences.en: But outside of the country, when people hear us say,
sentences.zh: 但在国外，当人们听到我们说，

sentences.zh: 大部分嘲讽来自其他非洲人，
